title: Half skull face paint portrait
summary: A clean editorial portrait with half your face painted as a skeleton and the other half natural.
why: Half-face skeleton looks are a classic Halloween make-up idea, and AI versions are popular this month because you get the look without an hour in front of a mirror.
steps: Use a straight-on selfie with your hair away from your face.
Paste the main prompt with the photo attached.
Try the glow version for a darker, party feel.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Use my attached photo and keep my face identical. Paint the left half of my face as a detailed skeleton: white base, black eye socket, black nose cavity, and teeth drawn over the lips and cheek. Leave the right half natural with light everyday make-up. A clean split exactly down the middle of the face. Dark charcoal backdrop, one soft light from the right, sharp focus on the eyes, editorial portrait photography. Vertical 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: glow in the dark
prompts.text: Same portrait, but under blacklight: the skeleton paint glows bright white and pale blue, the room is almost dark, faint purple light on the natural side of my face. Keep my face identical. 4:5.

prompts.label: Make it move (video)
prompts.text: Use the finished portrait as the first frame. The person slowly turns their head toward the camera and blinks once, the light flickers slightly, slow push in, 5 seconds, 9:16.

tips: Say which side to paint. If you don't, the AI may paint both.
Ask for "face paint", not a mask, so it follows the shape of your face.
For the video version, use Runway, Kling or Higgsfield image-to-video and describe only the motion.
